# Client wave 22 (w22tree), point 64: the element(s) of the damage each skill can inflict (the skill tree's Element filter). Made by
# client/tools/w22/build_skill_tags.py from rAthena (e985006): db/re/skill_db.yml, src/map/battle.cpp, status.cpp, skills/**.
# Do not edit: change the rules and rebuild. Read by Game/SkillElements.cs. Loki's own data: skill ids, rAthena's constants.
#
# E rows: a skill.  E <tab> id <tab> rAthena constant <tab> elements <tab> why (one per element)
# A skill without a row inflicts no damage of its own (a buff, a heal, a passive ...).
#
# THE RULES (battle.cpp battle_get_weapon_element / battle_get_magic_element / battle_get_misc_element, 3460-3545):
#   which skills      the ones that attack (the rule of skill_tags.txt: Type Weapon / Magic / Misc and it deals damage), and the ones
#                     whose sub-skills do: skill_db rows named <skill>_<part> that are in no job tree deal that skill's damage
#                     (WL_CHAINLIGHTNING_ATK); a skill with sub-skills and no Element of its own: only the sub-skills count
#   Element: a name   that element (a list per level: every level's)
#   no Element        Neutral (skill.cpp:15022-15024)
#   Element: Weapon   "Weapon": the weapon's element now; a bow's or a gun's ammunition and an endow go over it (battle.cpp:3468-3488,
#                     magic 3506-3511). A Misc attack: Neutral (3533-3536)
#   Element: Endowed  "Weapon" as well: the element of the endow on the user, Neutral without one (3489-3490, 3513-3514;
#                     status.cpp status_calc_attack_element). A Misc attack: Neutral
#   Element: Random   every element (3491-3492; only NPC_RANDOMATTACK)
#   its class         what its own modifyElement sets (src/map/skills/**) is added (a state of its user: Dragon Breath with Giant
#                     Growth); set without a condition, or "for the damage" (Shield Boomerang), it replaces the row's; the
#                     ammunition's element is "Weapon"; a line for monsters only is left out (Spiral Pierce)
#   an endow          a skill that deals no damage and gives a status that status_calc_attack_element turns into the weapon's element
#                     (Endow Blaze, Aspersio, Enchant Poison, Mild Wind): that element (FLAGGED: ENDOWS_COUNT in the tool)
